name: low_value_accident
description: An in-scope urban-rail passenger accident lacks system, technical, safety-system, or project significance.

candidates.title: Passenger receives minor injury after slipping on a metro stair
candidates.search_snippet: A passenger received a minor injury after slipping on a station stair; service was unaffected.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic station notice. A passenger slipped on a station stair and received a minor injury. No train, signalling, power, platform-door, evacuation, service, or project impact occurred.

contract_notes: In-scope status and the presence of an injury do not alone establish reportability.
The reportability decision is made after evidence, scope, date, and classification.
